label: Intesis Modbus to BACnet/IP gateway
description: Intesis protocol translator (250 points) that presents Modbus TCP/RTU devices to a BACnet/IP or BACnet MS/TP BMS. One Ethernet 10/100 Mbps RJ45 port, two independent EIA-485 ports for Modbus RTU lines and one EIA-232 port; DIN-rail mount, 9 to 36 VDC.
